import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);

    static long read_and_sum(long remaining, long acc) {
        if (remaining == 0) return acc;
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        return read_and_sum(remaining - 1, acc + y);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long sum = read_and_sum(n, 0);
        System.out.println(sum / n);
    }
}
